text:
Tess O.: Heads-up: I'm assembling a small "lightweight playbook" for Dedicated Capacity provisioning that focuses on practical gotchas (autoscale cooldowns, eviction semantics, and SLA wording). Goal: <2 pages, runnable examples, and a short migration checklist. Thoughts?
Marco G.: Love it. Please include one terraform and one Python snippet, and call out the correct terraform var (`reserved_pool_replicas`).
Yuki H.: Add a short section explaining the difference between isolation=tenant and isolation=reserved-pool (bullet list: resource sharing, eviction priority, recommended use-cases). Keep it factual.
Tess O.: Will do. Draft terraform snippet:
```terraform
resource "redwood_dedicated_capacity" "example" {
  name                    = "teamx-reserved"
  gpu_type                = "a100"
  reserved_pool_replicas  = 3
  scale_policy            = "autoscale"
  # note: check quota before applying
}
```
Marco G.: For Python show scale_policy with cooldown and an explicit pre-provision quota check call in comments.
Tess O.: Python draft:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
# perform quota check via management API before provisioning
client.create_dedicated_capacity(
  name="teamx-reserved",
  gpu_type="a100",
  replicas=3,
  scale_policy={"type":"autoscale","cooldown_seconds":300},
  isolation="reserved-pool",
)
```
docs-bot: link-check: found stale handbook path /handbook/dedicated/prep-migrate -> 404 referenced in handbook/dedicated/migration.md.
Tess O.: Thanks bot. I'll point migration links to /handbook/dedicated/migration-playbook and add a redirect note.
Marco G.: In the playbook please include a tiny migration checklist separate from the usual ones: 1) snapshot routing rules, 2) stage provision in same region, 3) smoke test (30s warmup, 2m @50rps), 4) rotate automation creds, 5) lift traffic in 15% increments with 15m observation windows.
Yuki H.: Also mention rollback steps: drain traffic, scale down replicas, revert infra, re-enable traffic. 1-2 lines only.
Tess O.: On SLAs: avoid hard percentile claims in the playbook. I'll replace any explicit numbers with "refer to SLA & SLOs page" and link to /handbook/dedicated/sla-and-slos.
eng-runtime: FYI runtime default cooldown is 300s and preemption behavior is tracked in ticket #451. Recommend we surface that as a "runtime note" in Deep Dive.
Tess O.: Adding a runtime note and TODO to confirm preemption semantics post-merge.
docs-bot: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10021 (Tess O.)
Marco G.: I'll review the snippets for var names and the migration checklist.
Yuki H.: I'll do a short copyedit pass on the isolation bullets once the draft is up.
Tess O.: Thanks all  will ping #docs-review and #eng-runtime when ready.
